title: Petition of Eastern Edison Company for authorization and approval by the Department of Public Utilities of (1) the issuance and sale of one or more new series of its First Mortgage and Collateral Trust Bonds in an aggregate principal amount not in excess of $100,000,000 (2) an exemption from the publication provisions of Section 15 of Chapter 164 of the General Laws, and (3) the accounting treatment for rate-making purposes with respect to certain premiums and expenses associated with the refinancing of outstanding series of First Mortgage and Collateral Trust Bonds.
